name: brayness
description: One Brayness product: sign-on, private sync, hosted VMs, models, and publishing
author: Scott Fryxell <scott@realness.online>

scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:renderer && npm run test:chat && npm run test:terminal && npm run test:frontend
scripts.dev:frontend: cd frontend && node scripts/generate-toc.js && vp dev
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:icons && npm run build:wasm && cd frontend && node scripts/generate-toc.js && vp build && node scripts/check-interaction-css.js && vp build -c vite.prerender.config.js && node scripts/prerender.js && node scripts/build-manifest.js
scripts.build:workers: cd frontend && WORKER_NAME=vector vp build -c workers.config.js && WORKER_NAME=compressor vp build -c workers.config.js && WORKER_NAME=tracer vp build -c workers.config.js
scripts.build:wasm: bash -c '. lib/output.sh && cd frontend && wasm-pack build tracer --target web --out-dir "$OUT/wasm"'
scripts.og:candidates: npm run build:frontend && cd frontend && CHROME_PATH="${CHROME_PATH:-/Applications/Brave Browser.app/Contents/MacOS/Brave Browser}" node scripts/generate-og-candidates.js
scripts.prints:previews: npm run build:frontend && cd frontend && CHROME_PATH="${CHROME_PATH:-/Applications/Brave Browser.app/Contents/MacOS/Brave Browser}" node scripts/render-print-previews.js
scripts.score: cd frontend && CHROME_PATH="/Applications/Brave Browser.app/Contents/MacOS/Brave Browser" lhci autorun --collect.url=https://realness.online/ --collect.numberOfRuns=5 --collect.settings.maxWaitForLoad=90000 --upload.target=temporary-public-storage && node scripts/print-lighthouse-metrics.js
scripts.deploy:frontend: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:workers && npm run build:frontend && cd frontend && firebase deploy --only hosting:app,storage -m $npm_package_version && node scripts/verify-deploy.js --manifest dist/build-manifest.json --url https://realness.online
scripts.version: cd frontend && node scripts/promote-changelog.js && git add CHANGELOG.md
scripts.release:gh: cd frontend && node scripts/check-release.js && node scripts/changelog-notes.js && gh release create v$npm_package_version dist/build-manifest.json --title v$npm_package_version --target "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" --notes-file artifacts/release-notes.md
scripts.ship: npm run deploy:frontend && npm run release:gh && npm run verify -- --release
scripts.test:risk: npm run test:coverage && npm run fallow:report && npm run test:risk:report
scripts.test:rules: cd frontend && firebase emulators:exec --only storage --config firebase.test.json 'vp test run -c vitest.config.storage-rules.js'
scripts.pre-commit: npm run check:frontend:fix && npm run type && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:rules
scripts.build:frontend:dev: npm run build:icons && cd frontend && node scripts/generate-toc.js && vp build --mode development && vp build -c vite.prerender.config.js --mode development && node scripts/prerender.js && node scripts/build-manifest.js
scripts.deploy:frontend:dev: npm run build:frontend:dev && cd frontend && firebase deploy --only hosting --project development -m $npm_package_version
scripts.test:terminal: node frontend/terminal/test/smoke.js && node frontend/terminal/test/smoke.js frontend/terminal/test/capture/pi.tui && node frontend/terminal/test/keys.js && node frontend/terminal/test/selection.js && node frontend/terminal/test/theme.js && node frontend/terminal/test/mouse.js && node frontend/terminal/test/reconnect.js && node frontend/terminal/test/open.js
